title: Railway RRB Paramedical CEN 03/2025 DV Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the DV Admit Card for the post of Paramedical Staff Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment was released for 434 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 09 August 2025, to 18 September 2025. The CBT examination was conducted on 10 to 12 March 2026. Candidates who have appeared in this Examination can check their RRB Paramedical Staff CEN.No.03/2025 CBT-I DV Admit Card 2026 from the link provided below.
applicationFee: After Appear the Stage I Exam
UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
SC,  ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
